commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/plotter-tools/omniplot"; V="$ROOT/backend/.venv"; echo 'FILES'; test -x "$V/bin/uvicorn" && echo UVICORN_OK; test -f "$ROOT/frontend/dist/index.html" && echo FRONTEND_OK; ls -ld "$HOME/Applications/OmniPlot.app" 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'PROCESSES'; pgrep -af 'uvicorn.*pen_plotter|finalize-omniplot' || true; echo 'DIRECT_LOG'; tail -100 /tmp/omniplot-direct.log 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'OLD_LOG'; tail -100 /tmp/omniplot-smoke.log 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'HEALTH_CURRENT'; curl -sS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:18020/health || true; echo; echo 'KILL_STALE'; pkill -f 'uvicorn pen_plotter.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18020' 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; cd "$ROOT/backend"; OMNIPLOT_FAKE_HARDWARE=1 OMNIPLOT_BIND_HOST=127.0.0.1 "$V/bin/uvicorn" pen_plotter.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18021 >/tmp/omniplot-final.log 2>&1 & P=$!; OK=0; for i in {1..50}; do if curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:18021/health >/tmp/omniplot-final-health.txt 2>/dev/null; then OK=1; break; fi; if ! kill -0 "$P" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done; if [ "$OK" = 1 ]; then echo HEALTH_OK; cat /tmp/omniplot-final-health.txt; else echo HEALTH_FAIL; cat /tmp/omniplot-final.log; fi; kill "$P" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -9 "$P" 2>/dev/null || true; test "$OK" = 1; APP="$HOME/Applications/OmniPlot.app"; rm -rf "$APP"; mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS"; cat > "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" <<'PLIST'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0"><dict><key>CFBundleName</key><string>OmniPlot</string><key>CFBundleDisplayName</key><string>OmniPlot</string><key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>local.plottertools.omniplot</string><key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>1</string><key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>launcher</string><key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>11.0</string></dict></plist>
PLIST
cat > "$APP/Contents/MacOS/launcher" <<'SH'
#!/bin/zsh
ROOT="$HOME/.local/share/plotter-tools/omniplot"
V="$ROOT/backend/.venv"
export OMNIPLOT_FAKE_HARDWARE=1 OMNIPLOT_BIND_HOST=127.0.0.1
cd "$ROOT/backend"
"$V/bin/uvicorn" pen_plotter.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8020 >/tmp/omniplot.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
for i in {1..50}; do if /usr/bin/curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:8020/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then /usr/bin/open http://127.0.0.1:8020; break; fi; sleep 0.2; done
wait $pid
SH
chmod +x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/launcher"; /usr/bin/file "$V/bin/python"; echo OMNIPLOT_READY
